name: Sakutto Panda ~Kutsuu~
source:
Main character trains diligently to defeat her bullies one day, but things take an unforeseen turn. Legendary attack prowess opposed by epic defense! The degree of craziness increases with every minute.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公刻苦训练，希望有朝一日打倒欺负自己的人，但事情却朝着意想不到的方向发展。传说级的攻击力对上史诗级的防御力！疯狂程度每分钟都在上升。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
